scenario.topic: Choose a fantasy football draft strategy for the new season

options.name: Early Running Back Focus
options.upside: Secures top-tier running backs early to anchor the team.
options.concern: May limit options for other key positions in later rounds.

options.name: Balanced Positional Approach
options.upside: Maintains roster balance by targeting multiple positions evenly.
options.concern: Could miss out on elite players at any single position.

options.name: Late-Round Quarterback Strategy
options.upside: Allows focus on skill positions early while acquiring quarterback value later.
options.concern: Risk of missing out on top-tier quarterbacks if others draft early.

options.name: Wide Receiver Heavy Draft
options.upside: Builds a strong receiving corps to capitalize on passing offenses.
options.concern: May underinvest in running backs, affecting rushing yard potential.

shared_context: The group of three fantasy football players must select a draft strategy for the upcoming season. Each strategy varies in risk level, player focus, and draft round emphasis to suit different team-building approaches.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a seasoned fantasy player who values a strong, reliable running back core to build her team around.
personas.private_goal: Secure top-tier running backs early to create a foundation difficult for others to match.

A.reason_for: Secures top-tier running backs early to anchor the team, matching my focus on a strong RB foundation.

B.reason_for: Maintains roster balance and flexibility, which can be useful if early RB picks aren’t available.
B.reason_against: Could miss out on elite players at any single position, which doesn’t align with my preference for RB strength.

C.reason_for: Allows focusing on skill positions early, but QB is not my priority in early rounds.
C.reason_against: Risk of missing out on top-tier RBs and limits my ability to secure a strong RB core early.

D.reason_for: Building a strong receiving corps can complement a solid RB core and add balance.
D.reason_against: May underinvest in running backs, which is less ideal but still acceptable.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a pragmatic player who prefers to maximize value by waiting on quarterbacks and focusing on skill positions early.
personas.private_goal: Draft a high-value quarterback late while building a strong skill position lineup upfront.

A.reason_for: Early RB focus can secure a strong position, but I find it too restrictive for my balanced approach.
A.reason_against: May limit options for other positions and conflicts with my strategy to wait on QB.

B.reason_for: Balanced positional approach offers flexibility and reduces risk, fitting my pragmatic style.
B.reason_against: Could miss out on elite players at any single position, but I value overall team balance.

C.reason_for: Allows focusing on skill positions early while acquiring quarterback value later, matching my preferred strategy.

D.reason_for: Wide receiver heavy draft can build a strong receiving corps, which supports my skill position focus.
D.reason_against: May underinvest in running backs, which could hurt rushing potential.

personas.name: Nina
personas.background: Nina is an aggressive player who likes to wait on quarterbacks and build a versatile team with strong late-round value picks.
personas.private_goal: Maximize late-round quarterback value while maintaining flexibility in early rounds.

A.reason_for: Early RB focus can anchor a team, but I prefer more flexibility and late QB picks.
A.reason_against: Limits options for other positions and reduces my ability to wait on QB.

B.reason_for: Balanced approach offers high flexibility and reduces risk, which suits my versatile style.
B.reason_against: Might miss elite players at single positions, but I prefer overall team balance.

C.reason_for: Late-round quarterback strategy fits my aggressive late-round QB value approach and skill position focus early.

D.reason_for: Wide receiver heavy draft can build a strong receiving corps, adding to team versatility.
D.reason_against: May underinvest in running backs, which could limit rushing options.
